season: Game 1.5.002 (live since 2026-10-08): cookie cap 120 by Crumble level, Gnome Lab 130-2, mileage Chocosteel and Syrup Metal
lede: Team power (전투력) gates stages and the Dimensional Rift: what raises it, what each source costs free and paid, posted gains, the spend order, and which systems raise damage where power decides nothing.
caveat: Refreshed 2026-10-10, two days into 1.5.002: the level gain is one comment (about +7.5%), Conquest damage weights are a leak. Few posted gains, almost all DCInside.
footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.

you.summary: At 2.2G your 35% reach is 304-19. Next free levers: cookie levels toward your Crumble-level cap, Stellar points to 8-3. For damage, gear lines beat power.
changes: Level the main lineup to the cap your Crumble level opens: one cookie level per 5 Crumble levels past 100, Lv.120 at Crumble 200.
Stay in a guild with research: leaving cost one player ~23% of account total (13G → ~10G); another saw stage power drop sharply.
Open and shape constellation-8 points up to 8-3: one step was worth +10% at 2G, about 304-19 → 308 at 35%.
Points past 8-3 need about 45 cookie stars from paid pulls.
Buy the mileage shop's 50 Chocosteel and 50 Syrup Metal every week; Syrup is plating's bottleneck.
Plate with drop protection only; skip shatter mitigation. Without bought Syrup, all plates to +17 before a weapon to +20.
Lab stones, not time, are the limit now: fill the crit rate and crit damage nodes you skipped before climbing.
Keep a power preset for 35% lines; at the 15% line and in Guild Conquest use the damage preset, whatever it shows.
Spend speed-ups on Mercenary Band Lv.4 for a second perk (Passion Pay: +20% ATK to your ATK #1 ally, Milk in Conquest).

team_power.lede: Team power growth: every system that raises displayed team power or damage, with its cost, cap, posted gains and the spending order by account stage.
team_power.caveat: Power gates stages and the Rift only. In Guild Conquest, Arena and the 15% stage line, gear lines and Fame count, not the number.

rules.title: Where team power counts
rules.body: Only stages and the Dimensional Rift compare team power with a recommended power (record 003's brackets). In Arena and Guild Conquest it decides nothing.

rules.title: Team power versus account total
rules.body: Team power (팀투, 덱투, 파티투력) is the lineup's figure the gate uses. Account total (총투) sums every cookie; crumb.gg's board showed it (top 500: 21.8G–50.8G, 2026-10-07).

rules.title: Arena excludes some sources
rules.body: Arena ignores Resolve, Stellar Link, the Gnome Lab, the guild lab and Fame. It counts level, promotion, pet holding effects, the collection, gear, plating and sugar runes.

rules.title: Damage, not power, below the 15% line and in Conquest
rules.body: Between the 15% and 35% lines a stage keeps 15% damage whatever the power, so pushers use the Conquest gear preset, which clears faster than a power preset showing ~900M more.
